name: Glock (off hand)
notes: Dual Glocks: shared clip of 20 (10 each), less control, slightly lower DPS, more burst. Right click needs 2 rounds.
pairing: Grants marker buff hwp_glock_off; adds its magazine to the shared clip.
secondary: With a main-hand Glock: fires both at once, 2 rounds, wide spread (burst). Otherwise one off-hand round.
